subject: [Co-sell demo] Redwood x AWS x BlueLayer - Marketplace & SI integration - scheduling

Subject: Redwood x AWS x BlueLayer - Marketplace & SI integration - demo scheduling

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Thanks again for agreeing to a joint demo with CloudSync Solutions — they’re very interested in both the Marketplace listing path and a technical walkthrough with BlueLayer for integration and co-sell enablement. I’d like to get a 45-minute slot on the calendar to cover: marketplace onboarding checklist, integration architecture, and go-to-market ops (who owns listing, co-sell handoff, and next steps).

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 10 Mar, 9:30–10:15am
- Tue 10 Mar, 2:00–2:45pm

Please let me know which works for you and whether we should invite anyone from Azure Marketplace for the cross-cloud listing conversation. Attaching a short agenda and the AWS marketplace checklist.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
